body.code_violation_desc: 1) This is to amend the NOV issued on 12/19/2019 2) A complaint investigation has revealed an unpermitted dwelling unit at ground floor consisting of a full kitchen, full bathroom, living room, and bedroom.  3) The garage door has been replace with two entry doors with sidelights without the benefit of a building permit and Planning Department approval.  Code/Section: SFBC 103A  Monthly monitoring fee applies. Code/Section: SFBC 110A, Table 1A-K

A complaint investigation has revealed that the garage door has been replaced with two swinging entry doors with sidelights without the benefit of a building permit or Planning Department approval. The complaint on this property also states that there is possibly an unpermitted dwelling unit at the ground floor. Code/Section: SFBC 103A  Monthly monitoring fee applies. Code/Section: SFBC 110A, Table 1A-K
